Institutional identity

New Anmol Group of Institutions

Private healthcare education in Vikasnagar, Dehradun.

New Anmol Group of Institutions is dedicated to academic excellence, professional development and holistic growth through programmes in Nursing, Paramedical Sciences, Pharmacy and related healthcare fields.

The institution combines quality education with practical exposure, experienced faculty, modern infrastructure and industry-oriented learning. Its educational purpose centres on innovation, ethical values, critical thinking, leadership, discipline, social responsibility and professional excellence.

Institutional focus

Teaching, training and professional preparation.

Modern lecture theatres, library facilities, laboratories, computer facilities, conference rooms and seminar halls support a learning environment designed around professional healthcare education.

Read the academic philosophy →

A community for purposeful learning.

Teaching, training, research and skill development are connected with independent learning, teamwork and practical preparation so students can develop as skilled, confident and responsible healthcare professionals.
